facts.fact: The AfDB communique says the Central African Republic's national fibre backbone, 935 km of terrestrial and under-river fibre installed and made operational, was inaugurated on 6 February 2023 and interconnects the CAR, Cameroon (via Gamboula) and Congo, as a component of the Central African Backbone project.
facts.system: Dorsale à fibre optique d'Afrique centrale (Central African Backbone - CAB)
